evidence.title: Vercel Introduces ‘Is Agentic’, a Free Agent-Readiness Scoring Tool That Audits Public Websites Using Ora’s 100+ Checks

summary: Vercel unveiled ‘Is Agentic,’ a free service that evaluates public websites against more than 100 criteria from Ora’s agent-readiness checklist. The tool aims to help developers understand how well their sites can be accessed and interacted with by autonomous AI agents.
title: Vercel Launches Free ‘Is Agentic’ Tool to Score Websites’ Readiness for AI Agents
